snippet.title: Stuffed Squid (Squid Sundae) at Abai Village in Sokcho, Korea [Gangwondo w/ Michin Alex]
snippet.description:
Check out Abai Village in Sokcho, Gangwondo Province, Korea!

The Abai Sundae (Abai Korean blood sausage) and the Squid (오징어) Sundae are both incredibly tasty, and the women who work the restaurants are so nice! After you're done, stop by the seaside and walk along the mural-filled alleys of the village.
Oh, and don't for get to go to the food area by taking that rope boat ;)

It's a small village by the seaside with a lot of character and tradition that is quite unique, especially considering that many of the people who lived there were North Koreans who were not able to return because of the 38th parallel drawn after the war.

요즘 한국의 젊은이들 중에 '풍류'가 무엇인지를 아는 사람이 그리 많지 않죠?
그래서 EBS 라디오에서 오는 9월 27일 수요일 저녁 7시 고양 아람누리극장에서 "풍류 그리고 한류”라는 특별한 콘서트를 준비했습니다. 
그리고 저도 한국 문화의 원류라고 불리는 '풍류 정신'의 의미를 알아보기 위해 '풍류 마스터' 임동창 선생님을 만나러 EBS 박정보(JB) 피디와 함께 전라북도 완주에 갔습니다.

Not many younger Korean people know what Pungryu is, and there’s an EBS concert called “Pungnyu and Hallyu” [풍류 그리고 한류] Wednesday 7 pm on September 27 of this month. So, I teamed up with EBS Radio producer JB and went down to Wanju, Jeollabuk-do Province to meet the Pungnyu master Lim Dong-Chang and try to figure out exactly what Pungnyu is.

EBS 신사옥 건립 기념 특집 콘서트 “풍류 그리고 한류” 함께 보러 갑시다!

snippet.title: Stuffed Squid (Squid Sundae) at Abai Village in Sokcho, Korea [Gangwondo w/ Michin Alex]
snippet.description:
Check out Abai Village in Sokcho, Gangwondo Province, Korea!

The Abai Sundae (Abai Korean blood sausage) and the Squid (오징어) Sundae are both incredibly tasty, and the women who work the restaurants are so nice! After you're done, stop by the seaside and walk along the mural-filled alleys of the village.
Oh, and don't for get to go to the food area by taking that rope boat ;)

It's a small village by the seaside with a lot of character and tradition that is quite unique, especially considering that many of the people who lived there were North Koreans who were not able to return because of the 38th parallel drawn after the war.

snippet.title: What is Pungnyu (풍류)? Finding the Korean Pungnyu Master
snippet.description:
"풍류의 명인, 임동창 선생님을 찾아서"
What is Pungnyu (풍류)? Finding the Korean Pungnyu Master

요즘 한국의 젊은이들 중에 '풍류'가 무엇인지를 아는 사람이 그리 많지 않죠?
그래서 EBS 라디오에서 오는 9월 27일 수요일 저녁 7시 고양 아람누리극장에서 "풍류 그리고 한류”라는 특별한 콘서트를 준비했습니다. 
그리고 저도 한국 문화의 원류라고 불리는 '풍류 정신'의 의미를 알아보기 위해 '풍류 마스터' 임동창 선생님을 만나러 EBS 박정보(JB) 피디와 함께 전라북도 완주에 갔습니다.

Not many younger Korean people know what Pungryu is, and there’s an EBS concert called “Pungnyu and Hallyu” [풍류 그리고 한류] Wednesday 7 pm on September 27 of this month. So, I teamed up with EBS Radio producer JB and went down to Wanju, Jeollabuk-do Province to meet the Pungnyu master Lim Dong-Chang and try to figure out exactly what Pungnyu is.

EBS 신사옥 건립 기념 특집 콘서트 “풍류 그리고 한류” 함께 보러 갑시다!
Let’s go check out the special “Pungnyu and Hallyu” [풍류 그리고 한류] concert together!

Date: September 29, 2017 (Wednesday)
Time: 7PM
Place: AramNuri Arts Center [아람누리 아람극장] in Goyang
*Line 3 (Orange), Jeongbalsan Station (Exit 3)

고양 아람누리 아람 극장
9월 27일 (수) 저녁 7시
*만 5세 이상 관람가*

더 자세한 내용을 찾기 위해 (그리고 관람 신청 방법):

http://home.ebs.co.kr/kculture/main

snippet.title: 외국인들이 부산 수변공원에서 회를 먹어보다! // Raw Fish Picnic in Busan!
snippet.description:
Alex     IG: michinalex
Marco IG: seoulmafia

알렉스가 마르코와 같이 부산 관안리 수변공원에 회를 먹으러 간다!
Alex and Marco go to Subyeon Park (Subyeon Gongwon) near Gwanganri Beach to eat some fresh raw fish in Busan!

알렉스가 한강 공원에서 픽닉을 많이 했는데 부산 바닷가에서는 처음이었어요. 그런데 다시 부산에 간다면 꼭! 한번도 해야 겠다! 너무 맛있게 먹었고 즐거운 시간을 보냈습니다^^
I usually have picnics at the Han River, which I love doing with my friends. But this was the first time having a picnic right at the water's edge in Busan! The next time I go to Busan, I've got to have this^^

snippet.title: CHALLENGE: Indoor Fishing in Korea [실내 낚시터를 가다!] ~ Hyehwa
snippet.description:
ALEX INSTAGRAM:      michinalex
CAMERON INSTAGRAM: cameron.word
www.alexsigrist.com

What's up, friends! 친구들아 ~ 안녕하세요^^
Alex and Cameron go to Hyehwa in Seoul to try some indoor fishing! And of course they make it into a contest because... uh... YOUTUBE!!! Enjoy their mini-fishing battle and make sure to check out all of Alex's videos to get more ideas for fun mini-outings in Korea :)
알렉스와 같이  카메론이 혜화에 있는 실내 낚시터에 놀러 간다! 낚시를 한지 정말 오래됐는데요... 물론 대결로 하기로 했어요 ~ 유튜브이니까^^

It's actually a fish cafe, so you can have unlimited coffee and soft drinks. If you want the American fishing experience, you can also purchase a beer there! A little bit of a buzz while fishing never hurt anyone...except, you know...brain cells and stuff (no drinking underage!)

실내 낚시터 뿐만 아니라 카페입니다! 무제한 커피나 다른 음료를 마셔도 되고 술을 마시고 싶으면 맥주를 사서 먹어 보세요^^

If you think Cameron didn't really win the contest, make sure to give this video a thumbs up! (And if he did win, you can still give it a thumbs up^^)
